# Impact of diversification of SARS-CoV-2 variants during the COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia against the escape of neutralising antibodies generated by natural and vaccine immunity

The genomic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2 in Colombia allowed to identify the import and autochthonous emergence of variants of concern (VOC) or of interest (VOI) of SARS-CoV-2 with mutations associated with immune escape or resistance to action of neutralizing antibodies (nAbs) generated by natural infection or vaccination. The vaccines against COVID-19 authorized in Colombia were designed before the emergence of VOC/VOI, so this study focused on evaluating the ability of local variants to escape to NABs induced by vaccination. IST-3, BNT162b2, ChAdOx1 or Ad26.COV2.S lineages were performed in individuals with homologous reinforcement, heterologist and individuals with hybrid-heterological immunity. The responses of the nABs were evaluated by means of neutralization tests, BNT-162b2, ChAdOx1 or AD26.COV2.S, in individuals with nabs strengthening, heterologist and individuals with NB2-NB2-NB-NB-NB-NB-NB-NB-NB-NB-NB-NB-NB-N The results suggest that heterologist reinforcement rescues neutralizing responses against VOI/VOCs at comparable levels with individuals presenting hybrid immunity. .
